next.reason: 1985 GR4 treats identifier-1, word-1 and literal-1 REPLACING operands as pseudo-text for matching. The 2023 COPY format (§2023:7.2.3.2, rendered PDF p.76) has no identifier, word or literal operand, and §2023:7.2.3.4 GR8 replaces only pseudo-text-1 or partial-word-1, so no 2023 rule carries this. The stray 'word-2, or literal-4' in §2023:7.2.3.4 GR9 has no syntax behind it.
